scenicChapters.title: Mortirolo Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 19 km this is Mortirolo Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Passo di Vivione
scenicChapters.narrative: 28 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-parco-pluritematico-molina-di-led.story: 248 km from Sonico to Sonico, about 4 h 17 of riding. The highest point is about 2,100 m.
